basic_profile.bio: Based in Seattle, I've always been fascinated by the latest tech gadgets and home automation systems. By day, I work as an IT support specialist for a mid-sized tech firm, and by night, I'm usually found tinkering with network setups or watching the latest sci-fi series. I'm passionate about helping others troubleshoot tech issues, though I find myself frustrated by poorly designed apps. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring hiking trails around the Pacific Northwest. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings during the week and sporadically throughout the weekend.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in IT support for over five years. My expertise is mostly self-taught through hands-on experience and staying updated with the latest tech trends. I have a strong understanding of network configurations and troubleshooting.
